literal: Having learned, here, the ultimate truth, those who realized [it] will attain the path of not returning here again.
translation: Those who have learned and realized the ultimate truth in this life will attain the path that leads to no return to this world.
modern: இவ்வுலகில் மெய்யறிவைக் கற்று, உண்மையான பொருளை உணர்ந்தவர்கள், மீண்டும் இவ்வுலகிற்குத் திரும்பி வராத நல்வழியை அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the ultimate goal of realizing the truth. Those who study and successfully perceive the true, unchanging reality (மெய்ப்பொருள்) while in this world (ஈண்டு) will reach a state or path (நெறி) from which they do not return (வாரா) to the cycle of birth and death. The repetition of 'ஈண்டு' contrasts the present earthly life of learning with the state of liberation from returning here. The term 'தலைப்படுவர்' signifies firmly reaching or securing this supreme path.
